reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must accept SAME [RECORD] AREA FOR file-name-1 {file-name-2}... in the I-O-CONTROL paragraph with AREA and FOR optional words, comma separators, at least two file-names, and several SAME clauses within the paragraph's one sentence, and refuse a clause naming fewer than two files, a non-file operand, a literal, and a misordered RECORD; the witness covers only the one-file refusal.

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.Edition.Year < 2002: the report-file row of the SR occurrence limits (1985 lets a report file be in any number of SAME SORT/SORT-MERGE AREA clauses); not the format shape

reader.edition-search: grep Edition.Edition/CobolVersion/Constructs/DialectBehavior in FileControlBinder.IoControl.cs (one hit, SameOccurrenceRule); grep Same in VersionConformancePass*.cs (only SAME AS); sameClause grammar carries no predicate.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the format shape is parsed and screened by the same code at 85 and 2023; the only edition arm on the path is an SR occurrence limit for report files.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness pins the one-file refusal; optional AREA/FOR, RECORD, commas, several clauses in one sentence and the record-area sharing at run time are not exercised by it at 85

probes.expected: SAME RECORD AREA FOR F1, F2 F3 accepted; records share the area aligned leftmost (GR2)
SAME AREA FOR F1 F2 and SAME RECORD F1 F2 (AREA, FOR omitted) in one sentence accepted
SAME F1 F2 (both optional words omitted) accepted

probes.printed: error COBOL2738: SAME AREA names only one file
error COBOL2738: SAME RECORD AREA names only one file
probes.expected: refused: F1 F1 is one file

probes.printed: error COBOL2738: 'W' is not a file specified in the FILE-CONTROL paragraph
error COBOL2738 only one file + COBOL1970 '"F2"' is not a clause of the I-O-CONTROL paragraph
error COBOL2738: file 'F2' is named in more than one file-area format clause
COBOL2738 'F3X' is not a file + COBOL3407 a separator period splits the run of SAME clauses
probes.expected: refused: the 1985 I-O-CONTROL format closes all its clauses with one period (§1985:VII.2.10.2)

reader.notes: The grammar superset-parses one or more file-names with optional AREA/FOR and ScreenSameOperands narrows to two or more distinct files of this program, the format's required file-name-2. Every legal spelling ran and every off-format spelling probed is refused by name.
